thread: FOI/EIR 00211027 — acquisition of land for Llandough Primary School
from: Information Governance Officer, Vale of Glamorgan Council (foiunit@valeofglamorgan.gov.uk)
subject: FOI/EIR request - Case Ref/ 00211027
body:
Dear Sion Buckler

FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT 2000/ENVIRONMENTAL INFORMATION REGULATIONS 2004 - INFORMATION REQUEST

Thank you for your request for information about: Llandough Primary School

Your request was received on 13/07/2026 and is being considered under the terms of the Freedom of Information Act 2000 and the Environmental Information Regulations 2004. Your query has been given the reference 00211027.

In some circumstances a fee may be payable and if that is the case we will let you know. A fees notice will be issued to you, and you will be required to pay before we will proceed to deal with your request.

You should receive the information requested within 20 working days unless the Council does not hold the information or there is a reason for it to be withheld. We will write to you in any event.

If you have any requirements regarding the format any information should be supplied in, e.g. the language to be used, audio, large print and so on, then if you have not already done so please let us know.

If you have any queries or concerns then please do not hesitate to contact us. Please remember to quote the reference number above in any future communications.

Further information about your rights is also available from the Information
Commissioner at:

Information Commissioner's Office - Wales

Second Floor, Churchill House

thread: FOI/EIR 00211027 — acquisition of land for Llandough Primary School
from: Information Governance Officer, Vale of Glamorgan Council (FoiUnit@valeofglamorgan.gov.uk)
subject: RE: Follow-up – FOI/EIR Case Ref 00211027 (Llandough Primary School)
body:
Dear Mr Buckler

Thank you for your email.

Our apologies that you did not receive a response to your email requesting the name of the officer who had acknowledged your request. We have previously advised that due to the Information Governance Team working collaboratively, and requests being managed collectively across the team, rather than by individual officers. Correspondence is not issued under individual names.

In regards to this request, we are still working on it. Your request was received on 13 July 2026 therefore, the 20 working days timeframe has not yet elapsed. We aim to respond no later than 10 August 2026 and will write to you as soon as possible.

Kind regards

thread: FOI/EIR 00211027 — acquisition of land for Llandough Primary School
subject: Re: Follow-up – FOI/EIR Case Ref 00211027 (Llandough Primary School)
body:
Sirs/ Ma'am,

Thank you for your response.

My query regarding the substantive FOI/EIR request is separate from my
request for the identity of the officer who acknowledged my correspondence.

I asked for the name of the officer who sent the acknowledgement email.
Your reply does not answer that request. Instead, it refers to the team's
general practice of issuing correspondence collectively.

If the information is held and you are refusing to disclose it, please
issue a formal refusal notice identifying the relevant statutory basis for
withholding it and advising me of my review rights.

If no individual officer's name is recorded or held in relation to the
acknowledgement, please confirm that expressly.

Otherwise, please provide the information requested.

I look forward to your response.

Yours faithfully,

Sion Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)

Royal Signals Cyber & Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member

thread: EIR 00210772 — internal review and formal chases
subject: Great House Farm, Llandough
body:
Dear Information Governance Team,

On 7 July 2026 I requested an internal review of the Council’s response to
my Environmental Information Regulations request (Case Ref 00210772).
You acknowledged this on 10 July 2026 and stated you were reviewing my
concerns and would be in touch further as soon as possible.

Over 20 working days have now passed with no further update or decision.
